sloka: वसिष्ठ: पुरत: कृत्वा दारान् दशरथस्य च ।अभिचक्राम तं देशं रामदर्शनतर्षित: ॥ २.१०३.१॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭha: purata: kṛtvā dārān daśarathasya ca ।abhicakrāma taṁ deśaṁ rāmadarśanatarṣita: ॥ 2.103.1॥

translations.english: Longing to see Rama, Vasistha, headed by the wives of Dasaratha, set out on foot (where Rama was offering libations).
